content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Rick Karle Good News's PostRick Karle Good News Verified accountMarch 15 at 8:09 AM · Shared with PublicA really cool thing happened yesterday.It was a milestone for a 43-year-old from Alberta, Alabama.He’s a man who helped Bama reach the Elite Eight of the NCAA Tournament in 2004.He’s a coach and a husband and a father of 3 kids, his oldest diagnosed with Autism.Antoine Pettway remains one of the most popular players in Alabama Crimson Tide basketball history.Whether it was his ruby shoes or his never say never attitude, the former walk-on’s class and kindness have been a part of who he is.Yesterday, Antoine Pettway- the men’s basketball coach at Kennesaw State- led the Owls into the 2026 NCAA Tournament by winning the Conference USA Tourney.I hope you can give your best to Antoine, his wife Kim and their 3 children, and someday down the road when Antoine is the head coach of the Crimson Tide, remember the heard it here first! *Picture courtesy Kim Pettway.The University of Alabama#BuiltByBama#kennesawstateuniversityAll reactions:6K850 comments220 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Top fanJosh GilesI said when I was in college that he’s gonna be Alabama head coach one day… But that was 20 years ago ￼1w7View all 2 repliesKim Walker43 where?
